info.description:
Backend of the Sinapse platform: identity, curriculum, educational relationships, learning record and study planning.

Every route lives under /api/v1. Errors follow RFC 7807 and are served as application/problem+json. Instants are ISO-8601 with offset; local times are interpreted in the account's time zone.
info.title: Sinapse Platform API

post.description: The account is created awaiting verification of its address. In this version an account holder below the configured consent age is refused: the guardian branch of the consent model exists in the schema but its flow is not implemented.

400.description: Body rejected, with the offending fields

409.description: Address already registered, or the accepted wording is no longer the one in force

422.description: Account holder below the consent age

post.summary: Registers an account and records the consents given with it

get.description: Without a date this returns every window ever declared, closed ones included, which is what lets a client show the routine and its history. The date is supplied by the caller rather than defaulted to today, because these are local times in the account's own zone and the server does not decide what day it is for somebody else.
get.summary: Lists the caller's availability windows

post.description: Times are local to the account's own zone and carry no offset. A window that would overlap one already declared for the same weekday is refused: overlapping windows would have whatever allocates study hours count the same hour twice.

400.description: The window closes before it opens, or stops applying before it applied

403.description: This account's learning data may not be processed

409.description: It would overlap an existing window

post.description: The window stays on record and keeps saying what it said for the period it covered. That is what a past plan was generated against.

404.description: No such window for this account

get.summary: Lists the classrooms the caller owns

post.description: The subjects declare which ones carry an institutional deadline, which is input for the optimisation core. They do not decide what the teacher will see: that is the visibility scope, and today it is everything.

403.description: The caller is not a teacher, or has no teacher record

post.description: Ends every active enrollment and revokes every outstanding invite, in the same transaction. The enrollments are not deleted: they are what justifies the access the teacher had while the classroom was open.

404.description: No such classroom for this teacher

get.description: Enrollment management, and distinct from the class list of section 3.6 of the API contract: it shows every student who is in the classroom, including one who has withdrawn their sharing consent, because removing them has to remain possible.

404.description: No such classroom for this teacher

get.summary: Lists the enrollments currently open in a classroom

get.description: Codes are returned in clear. That is why they are stored in clear, and why this route is restricted to the classroom's own teacher.

404.description: No such classroom for this teacher

get.summary: Lists the invites of a classroom

post.description: Ten characters of Crockford base32, about fifty bits. Expiry is mandatory; omitting the lifetime uses the configured default rather than making the code permanent.

400.description: The requested lifetime is out of range

404.description: No such classroom for this teacher

post.summary: Issues an invite for a classroom

get.description: Three fields per student, computed on demand over the requested window. Students who have withdrawn their sharing consent are absent rather than present with the figures blanked out. Returned whole, with a hard server-side cap: a classroom is naturally small and this API has no generic pagination.

400.description: The window is empty, inverted or wider than the server will answer

403.description: The caller does not hold the teacher role

404.description: No such classroom for this caller

get.summary: Lists the students of a classroom with adherence and total time

delete.description: Ends the enrollment. Nothing is deleted, and the teacher's access to that student stops at the next request.

404.description: No such classroom for this teacher, or the student is not in it

delete.summary: Removes a student from a classroom

get.description: The student's whole record over the window, not only the part belonging to this teacher's subjects: the scope is integral by decision P1, and the student is told so before accepting the invite. Requires an active enrollment and a valid INSTITUTION_SHARING consent, both read at the moment of the request.

400.description: The window is empty, inverted or wider than the server will answer

403.description: The caller does not hold the teacher role

404.description: The classroom is not the caller's, or the student is not currently readable by them

get.summary: Reads one student's adherence, effort and recall over a window

get.description: Includes withdrawn records: the holder is entitled to see what they consented to and when they took it back.

401.description: No usable session on the request

get.summary: Lists the caller's own consent history

post.description: The grantor is not submitted: it is derived from the holder's age at this moment, read in the holder's own time zone.

401.description: No usable session on the request

409.description: The purpose already has a consent in force, or the accepted wording is no longer the one published

post.description: Writes a new consent record in the holder's own name and withdraws the one a guardian had granted, in one transaction. The previous record is preserved. Either a token or a session identifies the holder.

401.description: Neither a token nor a usable session

404.description: Token unknown, expired or already used

409.description: The account is in a state that cannot reaffirm, or the holder has not reached the consent age

post.summary: Reaffirms consent after reaching the consent age

delete.description: Nothing is deleted: the record gains a withdrawal timestamp. Withdrawing an essential purpose suspends the account and ends its sessions, in the same transaction. Withdrawing ACADEMIC_RESEARCH has no effect on the service.

401.description: No usable session on the request

404.description: No consent in force for that purpose

delete.summary: Withdraws the consent in force for one purpose

post.description: Single use. Verifying the address is what moves an account holder of age to ACTIVE, provided the essential consents are in force.

404.description: Token unknown, expired or already used

get.description: Ended memberships are included: they are the record of which teachers had access to this student's data, and when it stopped.
get.summary: Lists the caller's own memberships of classrooms

delete.description: Ends the membership. Nothing is deleted: the record is what justifies the access the teacher had while it was active.

404.description: No such active membership for this caller

get.description: Closed goals included, because what was abandoned is part of what the student has decided. The status says which is which.
get.summary: Lists the caller's goals

post.description: The target date is a prioritisation constraint and not the plan horizon: preparation can run for a year, and generating a year of plan would be expensive and mostly wrong. At most one active goal per subject.

404.description: No such subject

409.description: There is already an active goal for that subject

post.summary: Sets a goal for a subject

patch.description: The subject cannot change: a goal about another subject is another goal, and repointing one would move the record of an abandoned subject onto a new one.

404.description: No such goal for this account

409.description: The goal has already been closed

post.description: Not a deletion. The goal stays, with the instant the student stopped pursuing it, and the subject becomes free for a new goal.

404.description: No such goal for this account

409.description: The goal has already been closed

404.description: No such goal for this account

409.description: The goal has already been closed

get.description: A requirement of ADR 0005 rather than a courtesy. The visibility scope is integral — the teacher sees the student's whole history and plan — and a consent to that which is not shown at the moment of deciding is not informed consent.

404.description: The code admits to nothing: unknown, expired, revoked, exhausted, or its classroom is archived. The five answer identically on purpose

get.summary: Shows what accepting an invite would disclose

post.description: Requires an active account with a valid INSTITUTION_SHARING consent, granted separately after reading the preview. A teacher cannot redeem an invite to their own classroom.

403.description: The account may not share its data with an institution

404.description: The code admits to nothing

409.description: Already enrolled, or the caller owns the classroom

post.summary: Redeems an invite and joins the classroom

404.description: No such invite for this teacher

get.description: Derived from the memberships, because a membership is the only thing that grants a teacher access. A period is an upper bound: access also requires a valid INSTITUTION_SHARING consent at the moment of each read, and withdrawing that cuts it off without ending the membership.
get.summary: Lists who could read the caller's data, and when

get.description: Each scheduled slot carries the topic and subject names and the session that executed it, if any. Days are grouped in the holder's own time zone. The window is mandatory and its span is capped: this API has no generic pagination, by decision.

400.description: The window is empty, inverted or wider than the server will answer

401.description: No usable session on the request

403.description: The account's learning data may not be processed

get.summary: The caller's planned sessions of a window, grouped by day

get.description: Assembled from each module, keyed by module. Delivered through this authenticated download and never by e-mail: a mailbox is not a place to put somebody's whole study history. Rate limited, because assembling it reads every table that mentions the holder.
get.summary: Downloads everything the platform holds about the caller

get.description: Including withdrawn and failed ones. None of them carries a copy of anything that was erased.
get.summary: Lists the caller's erasure requests

post.description: The account is suspended and its sessions revoked at once; the erasure itself happens after a configured window, and can be withdrawn until then. Signing in still works during the window, and does nothing but let the holder withdraw the request or take their data.

409.description: There is already an open request

post.summary: Asks for this account to be erased

post.description: Puts the account back to active, provided its essential consent is still valid. After the window has elapsed there is nothing to withdraw.

404.description: No such request for this account

409.description: The request has already been carried out, withdrawn or failed

get.description: Composed from identity, planning and the learning record. A holder whose learning data may not be processed still gets an answer — that is how they learn the account is suspended — but the plan, the job, the open session and the readiness flag come back empty.

401.description: No usable session on the request

get.summary: Everything the initial screen needs, in one call

post.description: Every session of the account is ended, including the one that asked, so the client authenticates again with the password it just chose.

401.description: No usable session, or the current password does not match

post.description: Answers the same way whether or not the address is registered. The alternative turns this route into a way of testing who has an account here.
Single use. Every session of the account is ended in the same transaction.

404.description: Token unknown, expired or already used

get.description: The plan in force, not every plan the student has ever had: this is what there is to do. The window is mandatory and its span is capped, because planned sessions accumulate with every plan and there is no generic pagination in this API.

400.description: The window is empty, inverted or wider than the accepted maximum

get.summary: Lists the caller's scheduled sessions in a window

401.description: No usable session on the request

get.summary: Lists the caller's own sessions

post.description: Answers with an opaque token, both as an HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict cookie for browsers and in the body for clients that send it back as Authorization: Bearer. Not a JWT: an account suspended by a consent revocation has to stop working on the next request, not at the next expiry.

401.description: Credential refused. The same answer is given for an unknown address, a wrong password and an account that is not active
No usable session on the request

delete.summary: Ends the session the request arrived on

delete.description: A session of another account answers the same way as one that does not exist, so that the route cannot be used to discover somebody else's sessions.

401.description: No usable session on the request

404.description: No such session for this caller

delete.summary: Ends one of the caller's sessions

get.description: The supersession chain is readable from the result: each superseded plan carries the identifier of the one that replaced it, and when it was replaced. Returned whole, with a hard ceiling, because re-planning is manual and this list grows in single figures.
get.summary: Lists the caller's plans

get.description: At most one exists. A student with no plan yet has not run the generation job, or its last run has not finished.

404.description: There is no active plan

get.summary: The caller's active plan

post.description: Returns immediately with a job to poll; it never waits for the core. The horizon is configured and is not the client's to choose. One unfinished job per account, and availability and at least one goal have to exist first.

403.description: This account's learning data may not be processed

409.description: A job is already running, or there is nothing to plan yet

post.summary: Asks the optimiser for a plan

get.description: Polled, because there is no event notification in this version. Once the status is READY the response carries the identifier of the plan. The progress field is absent whenever it is indeterminate, which in this version is always: the core reports none, and nothing here invents one.

404.description: No such job for this account

get.summary: The state of a generation job

404.description: No such plan for this account

get.summary: Reads one of the caller's plans

get.description: The whole plan, in sequence. This is how the sessions of a superseded plan are read: they are preserved untouched, because executed study sessions reference them.

404.description: No such plan for this account

get.summary: Lists the sessions of one plan

get.description: Total scheduled time, the breakdown by subject, and adherence over the part of the plan that has already fallen due. A session still in the future is not counted as missed, and the ratio is absent rather than zero when nothing has fallen due yet. Carries the optimisation core's fitness report as the core produced it.

401.description: No usable session on the request

403.description: The account's learning data may not be processed

404.description: No such plan for this caller

get.summary: Summarises one of the caller's plans

get.description: The window is mandatory and its span is capped. A history grows without limit and there is no generic pagination in this API, so an unbounded read would be a way of asking the server for everything.

400.description: The window is empty, inverted or wider than the accepted maximum

get.summary: Lists the caller's study sessions in a window

post.description: The application times it, which is what makes the recorded duration measured rather than stated. At most one session runs at a time: the screen is expected to offer resuming the open one instead of being refused here.

403.description: This account's learning data may not be processed

404.description: No such topic

get.description: At most one exists. The initial screen reads this so that it can offer to resume rather than start a second one and be refused.

404.description: Nothing is running

get.summary: The caller's running session

post.description: The marked exception of decision F5. The duration is always stored as self-reported, so the two sets can be analysed apart. How far back this may reach is configured, and the route is rate limited per account.

400.description: The session is in the future or older than the accepted limit

404.description: No such topic

post.summary: Records a study session after the fact

post.description: No rating and no duration. The student stopped, and the elapsed time of a session somebody walked away from measures nothing; what the record says is that it was opened and not finished.

404.description: No such session for this account

post.description: The recall rating is required and exists only here: a session that was abandoned has none, and a session already closed cannot acquire one.

404.description: No such session for this account

409.description: The session is already closed. A correction is a new record, not an edit

get.description: The identifiers a goal is set against. Subjects have no curated order, so position is their rank in catalogue-code order, starting at 1.
get.summary: Lists the subjects of the catalogue

get.description: In curricular order. Also where a topic name is resolved for a client that only holds the topic's identifier.

404.description: No such subject

get.summary: Lists the topics of a subject

get.description: Open, because the screen that collects a registration has to show the full text before there is an account to attribute the reading to.

200.description: The wordings, with their full text

get.summary: Lists the published wordings of the consent terms
